olivia: quick check 1 figma variants: 'chart-forward' (big stacked area + compact rows) vs 'list-forward' (full ledger with token chips). which one better for first-time users who land on billing? https://www.figma.com/file/def456 (img attached) mike: leaning chart-forward. new users need a clear spend trend up-front. ledger feels too much like accounting software and overwhelms. :chart_with_upwards_trend: tara: agree re: trend. one caveat: project-scoped teams expect per-project invoice affordances. If we hide per-row actions behind a kebab, will they find it? maybe show a micro-download icon only on hover. jon: perf + accessibility: micro-download icons increase visual noise if always visible. hover-only is bad for keyboard. recommend: always-visible lightweight affordance (small link text) but low-contrast, with focus styles that become prominent. aria-label should include scope (e.g., "Download invoice for Project X (PDF)"). mike: good point. copy brainstorm: 'Invoice (PDF)' vs 'Download invoice' vs 'Export billing'. prefer 'Invoice (PDF)' as it's explicit about format. ux-bot: accessibility check: ensure focus order preserves reading order. token chips cannot be focusable separately unless necessary. consider making token details part of the expanded panel controlled by the row button. Required contrast ratio for chips >= 4.5:1. olivia: interaction question: on desktop we can show a popover with token breakdown and quick actions; on mobile do accordion that reveals actions below row. Should the popover include both PDF + CSV links? tara: yes include both. For CSV include a small tooltip: 'CSV includes per-call tokens for analysis'. jon: analytics: add event 'billing.invoice.requested' with props {scope: 'org'|'project', format: 'pdf'|'csv', trigger: 'header'|'row'}. keep it small. mike: visual idea: show tiny sparklines on the left of rows for top 5 projects to aid scanning. hide for very small spends. sparklines must not be interactive; purely decorative with aria-hidden. ul: ux-bot: suggested ARIA sample:\n\n
\n \n Project X\n $2,300\n Invoice (PDF)\n
\n
token breakdown, actions...
\n\nolivia: decision proposal: default to chart-forward on initial landing, show prominent scope pill in header ("Scope: Org / Project") so users know which invoice CTA applies, have header-level invoice CTA for org-scoped downloads and per-row lightweight 'Invoice (PDF)' link for project rows. desktop: popover for details; mobile: accordion. lazy-render token chips + virtualization. analytics event shape as jon suggested. mike: agree. i'll update Figma with scope pill + sparklines and add hover/popover states by EOD. tara: i'll draft the microcopy variations and run a quick research poll. jon: i'll mock the focus styles and aria labels. will also add analytics spec to the ticket. ux-bot: checklist added to doc: focus flow, contrast check, aria-labels, non-color indicators for token statuses. :white_check_mark: olivia: thanks team, i'll schedule a 15min sync after Mike's update. :calendar:
